copied_material: Original license, original upstream package metadata/lockfile, and a one-line local patch. No upstream implementation, node_modules or binary is included.
package_metadata_scope: The package.json and lockfile describe the complete pinned upstream monorepo, including development and unused packages. They are provenance records, not a standalone Loom install manifest or evidence that every locked package is used.

modification.purpose: Honor the existing compaction.enabled setting before automatic overflow/length recovery. The patch adds this guard to the existing overflow predicate; it does not implement a new compaction algorithm.
